about: The stretches of coast the Coast map covers. Read by scripts/collect-coast-names.mjs (step 1) and scripts/build-coast-heights.py (step 2). Each area's files go in data/coast/<id>/. The app's own list (coast-areas.js) uses the same ids. Corners are [lat, lon]; the outline trims the box (for example to leave out the inside of Milford Haven).

areas.label: St Brides Bay — Ramsey and St Davids to St Ann's Head, with Skomer and Skokholm
areas.tideNote: Mean low and high water at Milford Haven (Admiralty): MLWS 0.7, MLWN 2.5, MHWN 5.2, MHWS 7.0 m above Chart Datum, which is 3.71 m below Ordnance Datum.

areas.label: Lyme Regis and Charmouth — a mile west of the Cobb to Stonebarrow
areas.tideNote: Approximate, from Lyme Regis's typical spring range (about 3.8 m) and neap range (about 1.7 m) round a mean sea level of about +0.2 m OD. Only used for the estimated foreshore, which is rare here.
